verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MMWE-ensozi-empanvu-ennyo,
Mujaguze mwenna!
-Ensenyi n'ebiwonvu,
Mumutendereze.
Muwulire-eddoboozi lye
Libuulira-eby'okujja kwe.

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
Mmwe-amawanga mwenna,
Muzuukuke mangu;
-Abantu bammwe bonna
Beefunire-eddembe
Ery'Omwana wa Katonda
Ly'abaleetera kaakano.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Amawanga gonna
Agali-ewala ennyo,
Agatamanyanga
Mulokozi w'ensi;
Kale,mwenna mujje gy'ali,
Oyo eyakomererwa.

verse.name: v5
